artifact.source: Existing local production Vinext build; not rebuilt during this audit
artifact.identityCaveat: Reviewed source identity is not an immutable attestation of these artifacts or a production HAR. Deployment-time release-variable overrides are not inferred from local build metadata.

bytes.method: Sum raw file sizes and each file gzip-compressed independently at level 9. App shell uses Vinext client-entry and client-reference manifest dependencies. Route estimates recursively follow literal static JavaScript imports from browser entry, app-shell provider, named loader and selected live experience. Dynamic imports are not traversed automatically.
caveats: Static dependency closure estimates, not measured network transfers or loading timings.
Route closures exclude some root telemetry and runtime extras; global CSS is reported separately.
Counts do not imply all generated demo and live assets are loaded on every route.

calendarDedupe.method: Synthetic local Node process with unique entries Array.from({length:n}, (_, i) => ({id: `item-${i}`, date: "2026-09-05"})); one untimed warmup then five timed iterations per algorithm, reported median using performance.now(). Fixture creation is outside the timed region. Captured values are from the audit run.
calendarDedupe.currentAlgorithm: entries.filter((entry, index, entries) => entries.findIndex(candidate => candidate.id === entry.id) === index)
calendarDedupe.equivalentAlgorithm: Use a Set of seen ids inside one entries.filter pass; retain the first occurrence and source order.
caveats: Measures deduplication only; not the full calendar preparation/render path.
Synthetic CPU evidence, not production latency, browser INP, or low-end mobile timings.
The alternative is benchmarked, not implemented by this audit.
